changes.text: 首先，本文主要依据《清史稿·张之洞传》，另引同卷《王文韶传》一条线索，未用《清史稿》以外的记载对照。台谏所说的「鐵路之害」是哪几条、海军衙门的理由为何，传文一概未录，所以本文只能写到「爭陳鐵路之害，請停辦」为止。

First, this article relies mainly on Zhang Zhidong's biography in the Draft History of the Qing, plus one lead from the biography of Wang Wenshao in the same chapter, and has not checked it against any record outside the Draft History. Which harms the censors meant, and what reasons the Naval Office gave, the biography records not at all; so this article can go no further than "pressed the harms of railways and asked that the project be halted."
本文主要据《清史稿·张之洞传》，另引同卷《王文韶传》一条，无《清史稿》以外的记载对照；议奏文字按史书所录转述，未必是逐字原话；「利」为他自列的理由，非独立核算；张之洞本传未记工期、用款、拆迁，同卷《王文韶传》所记京汉铁路兴筑是否即此线，未作断定；「得旨報可」仅为准奏，不等于开工；不换算公元年份，亦不假定他事先知道结果。

This article rests mainly on one source, the biography of Zhang Zhidong in the Draft History of the Qing, plus one lead from the biography of Wang Wenshao in the same chapter, with no record outside the Draft History for comparison. The memorial text is reported as the historians recorded it and may not be verbatim; the "benefits" are reasons he listed himself, not independent figures; Zhang's own biography records no schedule, outlay, or relocations, and whether the Beijing-Hankou railway recorded in the biography of Wang Wenshao in the same chapter is this line is left undecided; "approved by rescript" means approval only, not the start of work. No Common Era years are converted, and no foreknowledge of the outcome is assumed.

dispositions.rationale: 逐项复查后，现稿已经吸收了补入的 E18 至 E21，这里无需再改。具体如下：hook.0 与 context.2 写入了翁同龢、徐会沣的两种主张。story.0 与 analysis.0 写明七利和「分段分年成之」。story.6、limits.2 与 dek 把“未记修筑经过”限定为张之洞本传，并以存疑的口吻提及《王文韶传》的京汉铁路。story.8 写入了「家不增一畝」这一限定。由此产生的“单一来源”表述矛盾，已在 V1-V1 和 V1-V2 中另行修正。

evidence.quote: 翁同龢等請試修邊地，便用兵；徐會灃請改修德州濟寧路，利漕運
有此七利，分段分年成之
而京漢鐵路亦興築於是時矣

dispositions.rationale: 中英文都把“只依据一部传文”改为“主要依据张之洞传，另引同卷《王文韶传》一条线索，未用《清史稿》以外的记载对照”。这样与 story.6、limits.2 引用王文韶传的写法一致。同时在 ev 中补入 E20。
